heading: Bag Theft Offender Apprehended by GRP & RPF Vijayawada
newsTitle: GRP & RPF Vijayawada Arrest Accused; Gold Ornament Worth ₹4.8 Lakh Recovered
newsSummary:
On 05.12.2025, a passenger named Smt. Lakka Raju Vijayalakshmi of Vijayawada lodged a complaint stating that her handbag containing approximately 50 grams of gold (Chandra Haram) worth ₹4,80,000 was stolen at Platform No. 6 of Vijayawada Railway Station on 03.12.2025 while she was waiting for a cab to return to her residence.

Based on the complaint, GRP Vijayawada registered a case in Cr.No. 385/2025 under Section 303(2) BNS and initiated investigation.

Upon receiving the information, Sri J. V. Ramana, SHO/GRP Vijayawada, along with a joint team of GRP Vijayawada, RPF Vijayawada Post, and CIB Vijayawada, conducted a detailed investigation. CCTV footage from Vijayawada Railway Station, Command Control Center, and railway stations between Tenali and Bapatla was analyzed, and intelligence inputs were collected to trace the suspect.

On 12.12.2025 at about 15:00 hrs, the joint team successfully apprehended the accused near Platform No. 1 (South End) of Vijayawada Railway Station.

The accused was identified as:
Bottu Venkata Raja Shekhar (23 years), S/o Rambabu, resident of 4th Ward, Railpet area.

The stolen gold ornament worth ₹4,80,000 was recovered from the accused. He was arrested in the case, and further investigation is in progress.
